Old_Answer: Obi-Wan called out to Anakin after he passed away and taught him the ability to become a Force Spirit Fans have wondered for years how exactly Anakin was taught the ability to transcend death and become a Force Ghost. Finally this mystery was revealed in the short story, Brotherhood, from a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi. In the chapter “Brotherhood”, Anakin left his body of Vader and resided in the Living Force. However, instead of dispersing within the Force like most people, Anakin discovered that he kept his individuality, and consciousness actually grew stronger. For a time Anakin alternated between experiencing for the first time in his life true peace and for the first time fighting for his life, not because he wanted to live, but because he wanted to undo all the evil and suffering he had caused. As that happened Anakin heard the voices of his loved ones and finally he gave into the currents he was fighting. After giving in, Skywalker heard the voice of his old Master, Kenobi. Obi-Wan joked with Anakin telling him cause there was no Holonet for the poster boy anymore. Anakin respdonded sourly that he was no hero and then he had done terrible things and taken so many from so many people, including Obi-Wan himself. It was a watershed moment and Anakin began to confess all of his sins to his Old Master. Obi-Wan retorted that none of that mattered and a person is not completely made up of the choices that they make. Anakin responded that he wanted power to save others, but instead he destroyed them. Kenobi reassured Skywalker and told him that he did not make all of those those decisions on his own, and he doesn’t bear the guilt or sins of the galaxy, just his own. But Kenobi said he wanted his old Padawan to understand that the most important decision was the choice to chose life and goodness over death and darkness, that was the real choice and Anakin chose correctly. Kenobi then told Anakin he wanted to show him something. Kenobi transported them to the scene in RotJ, when Luke was burning his body and the party and celebration that followed. Anakin watched his children and their friends with happiness and a smile. Anakin mused on the thought that as a Padawan and a Knight he had always stood alone trying to solve everything for everyone and protect everyone. But he was never actually present in the moment with his loved ones as his children are right now. He realizes that all of his loved ones were always there urging him to let go of his attachments and be in the moment and he had never listened. His misguided beliefs of trying to be a ‘hero’, to be what he assumed others wanted him to be was always his ego. Letting go of attachments wasn’t as much as a physical thing as much as it was an acceptance of who he truly was and he had never considered that. Obi-Wan pointed out that the twins are what was best of who Anakin and Padme were. As Anakin accepted this he realized that he had manifested himself on the physical plane with Obi-Wan. Anakin then realized that he was wearing the Jedi robes a Jedi Master and became embarrassed. He told Obi-Wan it wasn’t intentional on his part, but Kenobi replied that Anakin might not have chosen it, but perhaps it chose him. Anakin then suddenly noticed that Luke was staring at him and could see him and then Anakin really looked at his daughter and realize how much she reminded him of Padme. Yoda suddenly appeared and told Anakin that his children had a hard and uncertain future road ahead of them. Anakin felt the urge (his ego) to try to step in and fix things, but this time he truly let it go. He simply told Yoda and Obi-Wan that he had faith in his children and for the first time ever, Anakin truly let go. That was the final lesson that Anakin had to learn, and he realized that that moment that it was of course, Obi-Wan that gave him the nudge in that direction . And if you wonder why Anakin appeared as his younger self, well that’s because the taint of Vader was gone once Anakin saved the Galaxy. Skywalker finally regained his loss humanity, and became the best version of himself which is when he was truly Anakin. I hope that clears up any confusion! In fact there were two promotional posters that have spilled the beans. Paramount realize quickly that they didn’t want to give away Spock’s name so quickly, without a story or episode explaining it, so they quickly removed his name. Though, at this point, the cat is already out of the bag because all of the other promotional posters have the names of the other characters and we know from hearing them on the show that those names are correct. Ishmael by Barbara Hambly Paramount chose the name that was previously attributed to Mr. Spock albeit from a non canon source. The name S’chn T’Gai originally was created by author Barbara Hambly in her 1985 novel Ishmael.
